tasks.q_en: You are sitting by a map of the forest with a thermos and a torch. The search team is waiting for your conclusions: where should they look? The surviving student sits beside you, wrapped in a blanket, telling his story slightly differently each time. What is he hiding?

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Mixed conditionals combine different times. Past → present: If + past perfect, would + verb (If they hadn't left the trail, they would be at home now). Present → past: If + past simple, would have + past participle (If he were the culprit, he wouldn't have come to help). Time words like then and now make the meaning clear.
tasks.q_pl: Mixed conditionals combine different times. Past → present: If + past perfect, would + verb (If they hadn't left the trail, they would be at home now). Present → past: If + past simple, would have + past participle (If he were the culprit, he wouldn't have come to help). Time words like then and now make the meaning clear.

Present → past: If + past simple, would have + past participle (If he were the culprit, he wouldn't have come to help). Time words like then and now make the meaning clear.

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Студент показує на карті струмок. Через годину рація хрипить: «Знайшли. Жива». Лісабон видихає, а Джейн відпускає своє дерево. Дорогою назад Ван Пелт сідає поруч із тобою: «Завтра Лас-Вегас. Казино. Кажуть, там хтось виграє занадто часто».
end_good.text_pl: Student pokazuje na mapie strumień. Godzinę później krótkofalówka chrypi: „Znaleźliśmy. Żyje”. Lisbon oddycha z ulgą, a Jane puszcza swoje drzewo. W drodze powrotnej Van Pelt siada obok ciebie: „Jutro kasyno. Mówią, że ktoś tam wygrywa zbyt często”.
end_good.text_en: The student points to a stream on the map. An hour later the radio crackles: “Found her. Alive.” Lisbon breathes out, and Jane lets go of his tree. On the way back Van Pelt sits beside you: “Tomorrow, a casino. They say someone there wins far too often.”
